source_order: InventorySpend writes ammo then INCInvDirty; next GameLoop UI can queue fresh digits only if screen enabled and buffer1 offset0. This observer does not assume which native cause occurs.
real_returns: InventoryHud A820 bank59 exits via native RTS A985 or relocated tail RTS BFFE; source metadata/opcodes freshly verified. Match actual bank59 and entry SP/caller word. Window-clipped returns recorded without claiming owner.
outputs: ONE bounded CSV +one small summary; original fixture still emits its existing eightPNGs/result/CSV only. No extra PNG/containers, RAM/input writes or guard wrappers.
screenshot_scope: Detailed before/after stamps and current committed HUD NT/actual mapped pattern reads only inside61-frame window. Outside screenshot calls only counted. Exact PNG object from original emu.takeScreenshot returned unchanged.
limitations: No per-scanline background-fetch callback; raw PPUADDR/PPUDATA callbacks and actualppu.videoRamAddr/state are serialized. Snapshot pattern/NT data are current state, not an invented raster epoch. Existing strict original hardware guards unchanged.
